mapper.select: WITH source_chunks AS ( SELECT embedding, coalesce(nullif(metadata->>'chunkWeight', ''), '1')::double precision AS chunk_weight, coalesce(nullif(metadata->>'canonicalBookKey', ''), 'BOOK:' || metadata->>'bookId') AS source_key FROM ${tableName} WHERE (metadata->>'bookId')::bigint = #{bookId} ), chunk_knn AS ( SELECT (candidate.metadata->>'bookId')::bigint AS book_id, coalesce(nullif(candidate.metadata->>'canonicalBookKey', ''), 'BOOK:' || candidate.metadata->>'bookId') AS canonical_key, (1 - (candidate.embedding <=> source.embedding)) * (1 + (coalesce(nullif(candidate.metadata->>'chunkWeight', ''), '1')::double precision - 1) * 0.10) * (1 + (source.chunk_weight - 1) * 0.05) AS rank_score FROM source_chunks source CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT metadata, embedding FROM ${tableName} WHERE metadata->>'bookId' IS NOT NULL AND (metadata->>'bookId')::bigint <> #{bookId} ORDER BY embedding <=> source.embedding LIMIT #{candidateLimit} ) candidate ), deduped AS ( SELECT canonical_key, MAX(rank_score) AS rank_score FROM chunk_knn WHERE canonical_key NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_key FROM source_chunks) GROUP BY canonical_key ) SELECT ck.book_id, d.rank_score FROM deduped d JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ck2.book_id FROM chunk_knn ck2 WHERE ck2.canonical_key = d.canonical_key ORDER BY ck2.book_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ck ON true ORDER BY d.rank_score DESC, ck.book_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
